Title: Azure App Service Environment v3 support for Windows Containers is now generally available

Body.Content:
Windows Container support in App Service Environment v3 (ASEv3) has reached general availability.  This support makes it possible for customers to migrate on-premises apps that require custom configuration to the fully isolated and dedicated ASEv3 environment, using Windows Containers.

This is particularly valuable for customers who need a single-tenant PaaS environment to satisfy compliance and security requirements, but don’t want to rearchitect their on-premises apps to run in the cloud.  Using a custom Windows container in ASEv3 lets customers make the OS and software configuration updates they need to make, while also making it easy to migrate to the secure ASEv3 environment.

Read the ASEv3 documentation.

Access the quickstart.
